tagline: Issues and before/after end to end: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.
intro: F05 · 21h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.

blocks.html:
• Goal: Issues and before/after end to end: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.

  • Spec: 03, 12.3 dictation

Steps

  1. Implement the Domain protocol under its real name as an actor that keeps everything in memory for now.
  2. Seed it with the 5 sample issues (critical, major, minor, one closed) — move the values out of App/Fakes/FakeData.swift.
  3. Add Debug-only (#if DEBUG) reset() (empty) and seed(); AppDevDataActions calls them from the dev menu.
  4. Register it in AppDependencies.

sections.title: 4. Real data — Issue logic and dictation

blocks.html:
4.1 Issue CRUD, carry-over, pairing
  • Goal: log issues, surface open ones next session, close by verification photo.
  • Spec: 03.1–03.2

Steps

  1. Closing creates a new .verified issue and links the old one; originals never mutated.
  2. Upload priority: critical 100 · major 50 · minor 10.
4.2 Phrase library, dictation, voice notes
  • Goal: on-device dictation and a usage-sorted phrase library.
  • Spec: 12.3

Steps

  1. PlatformKit/Speech/: SFSpeechRecognizer with requiresOnDeviceRecognition = true; vi + en; a protocol next to the real type.
  2. Voice note = audio Capture.
